NBSAP_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce biodiversity loss and maintain ecological integrity by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Include all territory in spatial planning and ensure effective management; conduct Red List of Ecosystems assessments; maintain the proportion of natural ecosystems and prevent further decline; integrate biodiversity considerations into general land-use plans and soum territorial development plans to reduce biodiversity loss; systematically reflect rare fauna, flora, and their habitats in these planning documents.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "All territory; natural ecosystems; land-use planning and soum territorial development planning.",
"Target Audience": "Authorities and planners responsible for spatial planning, land-use plans, soum territorial development plans, and ecosystem management.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced biodiversity loss, maintained ecological integrity, maintained proportion of natural ecosystems, prevention of further ecosystem decline, and biodiversity considerations and rare fauna, flora, and habitats systematically included in planning documents."
NBSAP_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "Restore at least 30 percent of degraded ecosystems by 2030 and improve ecological integrity and connectivity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Restore degraded forest ecosystems; restore land degraded by mining activities; restore degraded land, pastureland and abandoned land; restore water, wetlands, river and lake ecosystems.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Degraded ecosystems, including forest ecosystems, land degraded by mining activities, degraded land, pastureland, abandoned land, and water, wetlands, river and lake ecosystems.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "At least 30 percent of degraded ecosystems restored by 2030, with improved ecological integrity and connectivity."
NBSAP_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Include 30% of the country's total area in the special protected area network by 2030, representing major ecosystem types and strengthening ecological connectivity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Identify and assess areas under Other Effective area-based Conservation Measures (OECMs); develop, legalize and implement a national protected areas and conservation area strategy and action plan; designate forest, steppe and peatland areas under protection, including representative ecosystems; update the legal framework for protected areas and implement participatory conservation management; increase management effectiveness of protected areas; expand and conserve ecological corridors and connectivity areas; improve management through strengthened transboundary protected area cooperation.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "The country's total area, including forest, steppe and peatland areas, representative ecosystems, protected areas, conservation areas, ecological corridors and connectivity areas.",
"Target Audience": "Protected area and conservation authorities, legal and policy institutions, and participants in transboundary protected area cooperation.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "By 2030, 30% of the country's total area is included in the special protected area network, major ecosystem types are represented, and ecological connectivity is strengthened."
NBSAP_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce the risk of extinction of threatened species and conserve genetic diversity by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct baseline surveys on distribution and abundance; undertake assessments every 5 years in line with the international Red List criteria; protect wildlife migration routes and connectivity areas; increase wildlife-friendly linear infrastructure in line with standards; strengthen the legal framework for biodiversity conservation, sustainable use and reducing biodiversity loss.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity conservation, including threatened species, genetic diversity, wildlife migration routes, and connectivity areas.",
"Target Audience": "Stakeholders responsible for biodiversity conservation, wildlife management, infrastructure planning, and legal and policy frameworks.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced extinction risk for threatened species, conserved genetic diversity, improved protection of migration routes and connectivity areas, increased wildlife-friendly infrastructure, and strengthened biodiversity conservation and sustainable use frameworks."
NBSAP_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "To register, control, and assess the impacts of invasive alien species, and build capacity to combat and prevent their adverse effects by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Strengthen the legal and policy framework related to alien species; undertake research and establish a registry/database on alien species; assess risks, develop response plans, and strengthen capacity; register, control, and assess the impacts of invasive alien species; build capacity to combat and prevent their adverse effects.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Alien species / invasive alien species management",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for invasive alien species management and capacity-building",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Invasive alien species are registered, controlled, and their impacts assessed, with strengthened capacity to combat and prevent their adverse effects by 2030."
NBSAP_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce pollution from all sources by 2030 to levels that are not harmful to biodiversity, ecosystem functions, and human health.",
"Action/Intervention": "Promote sound pesticide use; establish a pesticide tracking system; introduce alternatives to chemical pesticides; identify soil contaminated by pesticide residues; strengthen laboratory capacity to determine soil pesticide residues; remediate soil contaminated by pesticides; adopt international IPSM standards; improve economic instruments for waste management; establish legal provisions based on extended producer responsibility and the polluter-pays principle; establish temporary hazardous waste storage facilities; translate and approve ISO standards on micro- and macroplastics in the environment; prohibit the import and use in Mongolia of chemicals newly added to Annex III of the Rotterdam Convention.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity, ecosystem functions, human health, soil, waste management, hazardous waste, and micro- and macroplastics in the environment.",
"Target Audience": "Implementing authorities in Mongolia responsible for pesticide management, soil contamination assessment and remediation, waste management, hazardous waste storage, standards adoption, and chemical import and use control; and beneficiaries including biodiversity, ecosystems, and human populations.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Pollution from all sources is reduced to levels that are not harmful to biodiversity, ecosystem functions, and human health by 2030."
NBSAP_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "Minimize the impact of climate change on biodiversity and increase its resilience by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement mitigation, adaptation, and disaster risk reduction actions through nature-based solutions and ecosystem-based approaches; conduct and expand long-term monitoring and establish monitoring points for climate change; increase carbon sequestration by expanding forest cover; strengthen risk assessment, early warning systems, and local preparedness under the Sendai Framework; integrate nature-based solutions into disaster risk management to reduce climate-related disaster risks.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity, climate change, forests, and disaster risk management.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced impacts of climate change on biodiversity, increased resilience of biodiversity, increased carbon sequestration, improved climate change monitoring, and reduced climate-related disaster risks."
NBSAP_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce ecosystem degradation by 2030 through supporting the development of sustainable, highly productive forestry and agriculture and introducing nature-based practices.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support the development of sustainable, highly productive forestry and agriculture; introduce nature-based practices; strengthen accountability systems by enabling contractual pasture use through primary herder groups; conduct pasture-use assessments; develop a methodology to determine pasture carrying capacity considering overlap between livestock and wild herbivore grazing; develop suitable methodologies to estimate greenhouse gas emissions from pastoral livestock production; protect cropland soil from erosion and degradation and implement response measures; reduce fertilizer and pesticide use through smart technologies; reduce chemical plant protection inputs by promoting mixed cropping; establish shelterbelts on cropland; identify agricultural lands negatively affecting biodiversity; diversify and develop model forestry/agroforestry.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Forestry, agriculture, pastureland, cropland, agricultural land, and agroforestry.",
"Target Audience": "Primary herder groups and actors involved in forestry, agriculture, pasture, cropland, and agroforestry management.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced ecosystem degradation; development of sustainable and highly productive forestry and agriculture; increased use of nature-based practices; protected cropland soil from erosion and degradation; reduced fertilizer, pesticide, and chemical plant protection inputs; establishment of shelterbelts on cropland; identification of agricultural lands negatively affecting biodiversity; and diversified model forestry/agroforestry by 2030."
NBSAP_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase the benefits of nature to people through ecosystem services derived from nature-based solutions by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Use ecosystem services valuation in policy, land use and sector planning to restore nature’s benefits in real terms; reduce sources of air pollution; improve air quality monitoring; increase secure sources of drinking water for the population and promote efficient use; implement nature-based solutions that provide ecosystem services.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Nature-based solutions, ecosystem services, policy and land use planning, air quality, and drinking water.",
"Target Audience": "Policy-makers, land use and sector planners, and the population.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased benefits of nature to people through ecosystem services, restoration of nature’s benefits in real terms, reduced air pollution, improved air quality monitoring, and increased secure sources of drinking water with more efficient use."
NBSAP_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase the area of urban green and blue infrastructure by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct campaigns for maintenance and protection of green and blue infrastructure; increase per capita urban green space to international benchmarks; organize citizen-based tree planting and maintenance campaigns; create artificial lakes and water features; integrate green/blue infrastructure into urban master plans and partial development plans; establish new urban forests, parks and green spaces.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Urban areas; urban green and blue infrastructure.",
"Target Audience": "Urban planners and local authorities; citizens.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Expanded area of urban green and blue infrastructure by 2030; increased per capita urban green space to international benchmarks; establishment of new urban forests, parks, green spaces, artificial lakes, and water features; improved maintenance and protection of green and blue infrastructure."
NBSAP_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop a comprehensive database for genetic resources and traditional knowledge by 2030, while strengthening legal and governance frameworks to ensure the fair and equitable sharing of benefits.",
"Action/Intervention": "Create the legal framework for benefit-sharing from the utilization of genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge; strengthen and enrich the electronic registry on the use of genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge; establish and develop a digital gene bank database, including detailed records of samples/specimens held in various collections and sequence information; translate and approve a series of biobank standards; establish a seed bank for wild plants; undertake genetic evaluation of high-value livestock breeds and establish a database; improve the legal framework governing conservation, storage, use, commercialization and benefit-sharing of food and agricultural crop genetic resources.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge, including biobanks, seed banks, livestock genetic resources, and food and agricultural crop genetic resources.",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for developing and managing legal, governance, registry, database, biobank, seed bank, and genetic resource frameworks and systems, as well as users of genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A comprehensive database for genetic resources and traditional knowledge is established, and strengthened legal and governance frameworks are in place to support fair and equitable benefit-sharing from the utilization of genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge."
NBSAP_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "Integrate biodiversity issues into the policies and planning of all sectors by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Integrate biodiversity conservation, sustainable use and restoration into medium- and short-term planning at all levels; apply the One Health approach in food, agriculture, health and environment sector planning and implementation; undertake social and environmental impact assessments for policies, projects and programmes at all levels; organize phased trainings and outreach for decision-makers and professionals across sectors on biodiversity conservation, sustainable use and restoration.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "All sectors; food, agriculture, health and environment sector planning and implementation; policies, projects and programmes at all levels.",
"Target Audience": "Decision-makers and professionals across sectors.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Biodiversity issues are integrated into sectoral policies and planning across all sectors by 2030."
NBSAP_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "To establish systems by 2030 to monitor and transparently report the impacts, risks, and outcomes of business activities regarding biodiversity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish systems for monitoring and transparent reporting of biodiversity-related impacts, risks, and outcomes of business activities; create an incentive system to support biodiversity-friendly start-ups; develop and introduce financial products dedicated to biodiversity conservation; assess contributions of businesses to conservation and increase the number of enterprises eligible for tax incentives; adopt international sustainability standards, including standards for reporting environmental impacts under international financial reporting frameworks.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Business activities regarding biodiversity.",
"Target Audience": "Businesses, biodiversity-friendly start-ups, enterprises eligible for tax incentives, and entities adopting sustainability and environmental reporting standards.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Systems are established by 2030 for transparent monitoring and reporting of biodiversity-related business impacts, risks, and outcomes; increased support for biodiversity-friendly start-ups; introduction of biodiversity conservation financial products; increased number of enterprises eligible for tax incentives; adoption of international sustainability and environmental reporting standards."
NBSAP_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "Minimize overconsumption and waste by 2030 through supporting public education on sustainable consumption.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support public education on sustainable consumption; develop ecological footprint accounting using international standard methodologies and establish a database; promote conscious purchasing and the use of nature-friendly products and services through behavioural change campaigns; promote zero waste and circular economy values through traditional nomadic culture and nature-friendly practices; support sustainable consumption initiatives to reduce food waste; promote household and institutional practices for water and energy saving and greywater reuse; integrate biodiversity, climate change and sustainable development content into general, technical/vocational and higher education curricula.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Sustainable consumption, waste reduction, education, household and institutional resource use.",
"Target Audience": "The public; households and institutions; learners in general, technical/vocational and higher education.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced overconsumption and waste by 2030; increased public education and awareness on sustainable consumption; reduced food waste; increased water and energy saving and greywater reuse practices; increased uptake of conscious purchasing, nature-friendly products and services, and zero waste and circular economy values."
NBSAP_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "Enhance the legislative, governance, and monitoring systems for genetically modified organisms by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improve the legal and policy framework on LMOs; establish a national biosafety clearing-house information system; develop and approve a package of MNS standards for LMO risk assessment; conduct baseline studies and risk assessments of genetically modified crop plants; accredit laboratories capable of LMO detection and risk assessment and strengthen technical and human capacities; improve LMO monitoring and import control.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Genetically modified organisms (LMOs), biosafety, and genetically modified crop plants.",
"Target Audience": "Institutions and stakeholders responsible for LMO legislation, governance, monitoring, risk assessment, laboratory accreditation, biosafety information management, and import control.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Strengthened legal and policy framework, governance arrangements, monitoring systems, biosafety information system, risk assessment standards, baseline studies and risk assessments for genetically modified crop plants, accredited LMO detection and risk assessment laboratories, improved technical and human capacities, and improved LMO monitoring and import control by 2030."
NBSAP_16:
"Goal/Purpose": "To reform subsidies and incentives that have negative impacts on biodiversity by 2030, while increasing environmentally positive (green) incentives.",
"Action/Intervention": "Ensure intersectoral coordination in subsidy and incentive policy planning; conduct environmental monitoring and evaluation of subsidies and incentives; repurpose potentially harmful subsidies and incentives in the agriculture sector; repurpose potentially harmful subsidies and incentives in the energy sector; repurpose potentially harmful subsidies and incentives in the transport sector; revise up to five regulations and policies on harmful subsidies and incentives using green criteria.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity; subsidy and incentive policy; agriculture sector; energy sector; transport sector.",
"Target Audience": "Sectors and institutions involved in subsidy and incentive policy planning, monitoring, evaluation, and reform, including those in agriculture, energy, and transport.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Subsidies and incentives with negative impacts on biodiversity are reformed, environmentally positive (green) incentives are increased, and up to five regulations and policies on harmful subsidies and incentives are revised using green criteria by 2030."
NBSAP_17:
"Goal/Purpose": "To substantially and progressively increase financial resources towards biodiversity conservation from all sources, in an effective, timely, innovative and easily accessible manner.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase private sector financing for biodiversity within biodiversity finance systems and environmental and social responsibility frameworks; raise public expenditure on the environment sector to internationally comparable levels as a share of GDP; adopt the revised Law on Natural Resource Use Fees and strengthen implementation; transition total environmental sector financing to results-based budgeting; comprehensively upgrade the budget and expenditure database for environmental protection and restoration measures by linking it with databases and systems of other government agencies; establish the legal basis to collect a 'Nature Benefit Fee' from foreign citizens and allocate it to biodiversity conservation; increase conservation revenues by strengthening the legal framework and implementation of biodiversity offsetting; study and pilot biodiversity credits and other innovative mechanisms for biodiversity action.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity conservation; environment sector; environmental protection and restoration measures.",
"Target Audience": "Private sector actors; public sector/government agencies; foreign citizens.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Substantially and progressively increased financial resources for biodiversity conservation from all sources, with financing delivered in an effective, timely, innovative and easily accessible manner; increased conservation revenues; public expenditure on the environment sector raised as a share of GDP; environmental sector financing transitioned to results-based budgeting; legal and institutional mechanisms established or strengthened for resource mobilization."
NBSAP_18:
"Goal/Purpose": "Strengthen capacity-building and development, access to and transfer of technology, and promote development of and access to innovation and technical and scientific cooperation in biodiversity conservation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the number and financing of projects supported by the Science and Technology Fund for biodiversity conservation; strengthen cooperation among government, private sector and international programmes to expand innovation and technical cooperation in the environment sector; support environmental sector professionals and provide scholarships for students and researchers; upgrade research laboratories and equipment in the environment sector, improve accessibility, and strengthen monitoring and human resource capacity; improve access to and transfer of technology; promote development of and access to innovation and technical and scientific cooperation in biodiversity conservation.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity conservation; environment sector.",
"Target Audience": "Government, private sector, international programmes, environmental sector professionals, students, researchers.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased number and financing of biodiversity conservation projects; expanded innovation and technical cooperation in the environment sector; improved support for environmental professionals, students and researchers; upgraded laboratories and equipment, improved accessibility, and strengthened monitoring and human resource capacity in biodiversity conservation."
NBSAP_19:
"Goal/Purpose": "To ensure that by 2030, data and information relevant to biodiversity and ecosystem services are widely accessible to decision makers, scientists and the public in order to guide effective and equitable governance and integrated and participatory management of biodiversity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Make biodiversity- and ecosystem service-related data and information widely accessible; conduct trainings and outreach to promote sustainable use of natural resources, associated traditional knowledge related to genetic resources, prevention of illegal wildlife and plant trade, and awareness on LMOs and alien species; increase access to information and conduct trainings and outreach among customs, judiciary, prosecutors, environmental police and relevant public officials on prevention of illegal wildlife and plant trade and environmental crimes and offences; promote nature-based solutions and green technologies through multi-stakeholder outreach and encourage active participation; broadcast environmental news, information and educational programmes for at least 2 per cent of total airtime on Mongolia’s national public radio and television; organize multi-stakeholder campaigns on environmentally friendly green technologies and encourage participation; systematically incorporate information on the value and importance of biodiversity into editorial policies of media outlets and strengthen journalists’ capacity; establish a master’s programme in environmental journalism and train specialized journalists.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity and ecosystem services governance, biodiversity management, environmental information and communication, and natural resource use.",
"Target Audience": "Decision makers, scientists, the public, customs, judiciary, prosecutors, environmental police, relevant public officials, media outlets, journalists, and multi-stakeholder participants.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Data and information relevant to biodiversity and ecosystem services are widely accessible by 2030, supporting effective and equitable governance and integrated and participatory management of biodiversity; increased public information and awareness through media and outreach; strengthened capacity among public officials and journalists."
NBSAP_20:
"Goal/Purpose": "Ensure by 2030 full, equitable, inclusive, effective, and gender-responsive representation and participation in biodiversity-related decision-making and implementation, and ensure rights over relevant resources of local communities, women and girls, and youth.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organize annual regional trainings on women’s participation and leadership in environmental sector decision-making; undertake research and develop recommendations on the linkages between biodiversity, traditional conservation knowledge and gender; build the capacity of local communities, women and youth engaged in nature-dependent businesses by supporting nature-friendly good practices; strengthen the knowledge and capacity of institutions implementing the biodiversity strategy and action plan to use sex-disaggregated data in policy and planning and to develop and apply gender-responsive indicators; ensure representation and participation in biodiversity-related decision-making and implementation; ensure rights over relevant resources.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity; environmental sector decision-making and implementation; nature-dependent businesses.",
"Target Audience": "Local communities, women and girls, youth, institutions implementing the biodiversity strategy and action plan, and women participating in environmental sector decision-making.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Full, equitable, inclusive, effective, and gender-responsive participation and representation in biodiversity-related decision-making and implementation by 2030; strengthened institutional use of sex-disaggregated data and gender-responsive indicators; improved capacity of local communities, women, and youth engaged in nature-dependent businesses to apply nature-friendly practices; recommendations developed on biodiversity, traditional conservation knowledge, and gender; rights over relevant resources ensured for local communities, women and girls, and youth."
NAP_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "Support climate change adaptation across all sectors by enhancing policies, legal structures, and organizational capacities.",
"Action/Intervention": "Enhance policies, legal structures, and organizational capacities; establish legal regulations to ensure integrated coordination for reducing disaster risks induced by climate, water, and weather and for adapting to climate change; improve intersectoral coordination; approve and ensure implementation of the National Biodiversity programme and Plan.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate change adaptation across all sectors; disaster risk reduction related to climate, water, and weather; biodiversity.",
"Target Audience": "All sectors; institutions and organizations responsible for policy, legal regulation, coordination, climate change adaptation, disaster risk reduction, and implementation of the National Biodiversity programme and Plan.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved support for climate change adaptation across all sectors; integrated coordination for reducing climate-, water-, and weather-induced disaster risks; improved intersectoral coordination; approved and implemented National Biodiversity programme and Plan."
NAP_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve climate change adaptation knowledge and capacity among stakeholders.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct research to identify social groups vulnerable to climate change and study the dynamics of their livelihoods; organize training and capacity development activities at the national level; disseminate information on climate change risks and adaptation measures to government employees and populations vulnerable to climate change.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate change adaptation.",
"Target Audience": "Stakeholders, including government employees and populations vulnerable to climate change.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved knowledge and capacity on climate change adaptation among stakeholders, including better-informed vulnerable groups and government employees regarding climate change risks and adaptation measures."
NAP_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve the adaptive capacity of ecosystems and biodiversity",
"Action/Intervention": "Take under special protection and improve management of at least 35 percent of each main representative ecosystems, and entire ecosystems that are unique and vulnerable to climate change; establish a comprehensive surveillance and control system for changes in the population number, habitat, and species migration of wild animals due to climate change",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Ecosystems and biodiversity, including main representative ecosystems, unique and climate-vulnerable ecosystems, and wild animal habitats",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "At least 35 percent of each main representative ecosystem is under special protection and improved management; entire unique and climate-vulnerable ecosystems are protected and managed; a comprehensive system is established to monitor and control changes in wild animal population number, habitat, and species migration due to climate change"
NAP_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce desertification, land degradation, and permafrost loss.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement actions to protect and increase water resources by establishing forest strips suitable to the geographical location and regional features in areas affected by desertification; take peatlands under special state protection; promote rehabilitation and sustainable use of degraded lands.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Areas affected by desertification, degraded lands, peatlands, and permafrost areas.",
"Target Audience": "State authorities and land managers in areas affected by desertification, degraded lands, peatlands, and permafrost areas.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced area of land affected by desertification and degradation; peatlands under special state protection; rehabilitation and sustainable use of degraded lands; reduced permafrost loss."
NAP_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish a continuous water monitoring system using advanced technology for sustainable management.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a monitoring network for water quality and water resource replenishment of underground water replenishment facilities, using advanced technology.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources, including water quality and underground water replenishment facilities.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly provided.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Continuous monitoring of water quality and water resource replenishment to support sustainable management."
NAP_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "Strengthen water ecosystem services by conserving and restoring water resources, and by utilizing technology to boost surface water.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conserve and restore water resources; utilize technology to boost surface water; accumulate a total of 6.4 km3 of water resources through surface water collection; build ponds for hay and crop irrigation and ponds for breeding of fish and aquatic animals; create overfloading sites by constructing traditional small-scale ponds to solve water supply of wildlife and livestock.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources and water ecosystem services.",
"Target Audience": "Implementers responsible for water resource conservation, restoration, surface water collection, and pond construction; beneficiaries include wildlife, livestock, and those involved in hay and crop irrigation and breeding of fish and aquatic animals.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Strengthened water ecosystem services; conserved and restored water resources; increased surface water; accumulation of 6.4 km3 of water resources; improved water supply for wildlife and livestock; support for hay and crop irrigation and breeding of fish and aquatic animals."
NAP_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish sustainable forest management, climate-resilient natural forests, and improved reforestation and afforestation capacity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a forest seed bank and supply reproductive materials; implement the national movement on reforestation and afforestation, including urban areas; carry out sustainable forest management and forest protection.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Forests, natural forests, and urban areas related to reforestation and afforestation.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target or associated actions/measures.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Sustainable forest management established, natural forests made more climate-resilient, and reforestation and afforestation capacity improved."
NAP_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "Minimize risks from climate change induced disasters and improve resilience",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop a database for weather and climate change disasters, risks, damage, risk insurance information, and data sharing management; improve the insurance system to reduce climate and hydrometeorological hazards and disaster risks",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate change disaster risk management and hydrometeorological hazards",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced risks from climate change induced disasters and improved resilience"
NAP_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop multi-hazard, impact-based early warning systems that enable quick and effective responses to extreme events.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the forecasting and computing capacity of supercomputers; provide early warning of catastrophic events; improve the spatial and temporal accuracy, probability, and accuracy of forecasting; and establish and introduce an early warning system based on multiple impacts, including drought, dzud, flood, strong wind, heavy snow, and rain, at the urban and regional level.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Early warning systems for extreme events at the urban and regional level.",
"Target Audience": "Urban and regional-level stakeholders responsible for early warning systems and response to extreme events.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Quick and effective responses to extreme events, supported by improved forecasting capacity and greater spatial and temporal forecasting accuracy."
NAP_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "Foster sustainable livestock management that aligns with water and pasture resources and is climate-resilient.",
"Action/Intervention": "Set the boundaries of the winter-spring pastures of herders and their communities; ensure the management of the long-term use of the pastures by the herders; establish water points, wells and ponds to improve the water supply of pastures.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock management in pasture areas, including winter-spring pastures and their water resources.",
"Target Audience": "Herders and their communities.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Sustainable and climate-resilient livestock management aligned with available water and pasture resources, with improved long-term pasture use management and improved water supply of pastures."
NAP_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve livestock quality, reduce pasture overuse, and develop value chains for marketable livestock products.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop marketing strategies to enhance the sale of livestock and livestock products; introduce technologies to track the registry of origin and movement of livestock; establish protected farms with veterinary quarantine; reduce the number of livestock suffering from emerging and resurgent veterinary diseases.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock sector, pasture management, and livestock product value chains.",
"Target Audience": "Livestock sector stakeholders involved in livestock production, pasture management, animal health, and marketing of livestock and livestock products.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Enhanced sale of livestock and livestock products, improved livestock quality, reduced pasture overuse, strengthened livestock product value chains, improved traceability of livestock origin and movement, establishment of protected farms with veterinary quarantine, and reduced incidence of emerging and resurgent veterinary diseases in livestock."
NAP_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "Sustainably develop high-yield crops through climate-adapted technologies and soil conservation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the number of crop rotations that are beneficial for soil fertility and economically efficient; reduce the percentage of black fallow; increase the cultivation of leguminous and other food and fodder crops; build reservoirs, marshes, and ponds to use snow and rain flood water for improving water supply and use it for irrigation of fodder crops, potatoes, and vegetables; grow a forest strip on agricultural fields fenced off by farmers; apply climate-adapted technologies and soil conservation measures.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agricultural fields and crop production systems.",
"Target Audience": "Farmers.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Development of high-yield crops in a sustainable manner, with improved soil fertility and water supply for irrigation of fodder crops, potatoes, and vegetables."
NAP_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "Protect and sustain soil fertility through climate-smart agricultural practices.",
"Action/Intervention": "Introduction of crops and varieties resistant to drought, diseases and pests, and improvement of seed supply of varieties.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture",
"Target Audience": "Agricultural sector stakeholders",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Protected and sustained soil fertility."
NAP_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "Mitigate climate-related health risks.",
"Action/Intervention": "Enhance research, preparedness, and capacity-building, and develop evidence-based public health recommendations versus climate change-induced morbidity and mortality.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Public health",
"Target Audience": "Public health stakeholders",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced climate change-induced morbidity and mortality."
NAP_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce the vulnerability of communities through social safety nets, protection systems, and insurance mechanisms.",
"Action/Intervention": "Create social safety nets, protection systems, and insurance mechanisms; engage target groups vulnerable to climate change, and people migrated to urban areas due to loss of their livelihood sources through natural disasters, in occupational orientation training.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Communities affected by climate change and natural disasters, including urban areas receiving people who migrated due to loss of livelihood sources.",
"Target Audience": "Communities vulnerable to climate change; target groups vulnerable to climate change; people migrated to urban areas due to loss of their livelihood sources through natural disasters.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced vulnerability of communities."
NDC_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve the adaptive capacity and resilience of biodiversity vulnerable to climate change through expanded legal protection of land and support for species movement.",
"Action/Intervention": "Enlarge the boundaries of protected areas; designate ecological corridors; enable species migration and movement; update Red List assessments for flora and fauna to identify climate-vulnerable species and enhance their protection; conduct vegetation and resource assessments by ecological zones and plant communities; carry out phased research and monitoring of animal species, their populations, and distribution.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Protected areas, ecological corridors, land, ecological zones, plant communities, flora and fauna, biodiversity vulnerable to climate change.",
"Target Audience": "Flora and fauna, including climate-vulnerable species; biodiversity vulnerable to climate change.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Expanded legal protection of land, improved protection of climate-vulnerable species, enabled species migration and movement, and improved adaptive capacity and resilience of biodiversity vulnerable to climate change."
NDC_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "Strengthen protection and sustainable use measures that support the regeneration of vulnerable and unique ecosystems, and establish long-term ecological monitoring and targeted conservation research and actions.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement conservation and sustainable use projects tailored to the recovery capacity of ecosystems across ecological zones, peatland restoration areas, ecological corridors and ecological infostructures; apply species-specific protection measures within protected areas to support the recovery of critically endangered and rare species; preserve genetic diversity of plants, crops, and animals by establishing gene banks and promoting sustainable use through policy and planning; establish long-term ecological monitoring sites; carry out targeted conservation research and actions; protect 30% and an additional 3.1% of the total area to achieve 33.1% of the country's total territory protected by 2035 in Mongolia.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Vulnerable and unique ecosystems across ecological zones, peatland restoration areas, ecological corridors, ecological infostructures, protected areas, and the total territory of Mongolia.",
"Target Audience": "Protected area managers, conservation and sustainable use project implementers, species protection authorities, gene bank and policy/planning institutions.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Regeneration of vulnerable and unique ecosystems; recovery of critically endangered and rare species; preservation of genetic diversity of plants, crops, and animals; establishment of long-term ecological monitoring sites; implementation of targeted conservation research and actions; and protection of 33.1% of Mongolia's total territory by 2035."
NDC_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve the policy, legal, structural, and organizational environment for the climate change adaptation of the sector.",
"Action/Intervention": "Revise irrigation regimes and water use norms for pastures, agriculture, forests, industry, and mining to increase recycling and introduce water-efficient technologies; establish a permanent monitoring system for water use; determine ecological flows and sustainable abstraction levels through hydrological and biological studies to guide rational water management; update flood runoff standards and implement structural standards for protective infrastructure and flow capacity assessments.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "The sector; water use and water management in pastures, agriculture, forests, industry, and mining; flood-related infrastructure and flow capacity.",
"Target Audience": "Pastures, agriculture, forests, industry, and mining sectors.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased recycling and introduction of water-efficient technologies; establishment of a permanent water use monitoring system; determination of ecological flows and sustainable abstraction levels to guide rational water management; updated flood runoff standards and implemented structural standards for protective infrastructure and flow capacity assessments."
NDC_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "Enhance the resilience of the water sector through the utilization of advanced technologies for conservation, restoration, sustainable use and secure water availability.",
"Action/Intervention": "Utilize advanced technologies for water conservation, restoration, sustainable use and secure water availability; include river headwater sources under special protection; expand medium-scale hydrogeological mapping to assess water resources; increase monitoring of groundwater wells and improve databases and reporting mechanisms; create water accumulation facilities and ponds in humid and sub-humid zones; support national satellite technology to monitor glaciers, lakes, and reservoirs and automate hydrological data transmission and acquisition; regulate the thermal regime of water through riparian forestation and monitor its effectiveness; restore and expand surface-groundwater interaction monitoring networks and water balance assessment systems; implement Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR) systems, covered reservoirs, and infiltration wells in arid and semi-arid regions through partnerships between local governments, the private sector, the mining industry, and light and heavy industry; in cool and moderately humid zones, construct irrigation ponds for hay and crop cultivation, fish and aquatic species breeding ponds, and community ponds, develop natural overflow systems, and deliver water through canals and pipelines to wildlife and livestock in semi-arid and arid areas; support pasture irrigation and household water use by delivering water to drying endorheic lakes, enabling cultivation of berries, vegetables, and household-level fish farming; regulate the thermal regime of river and lake waters through shading from riparian forests, implement ecosystem protection measures, and support breeding of native fish species; conditionally retain projected meltwater in upstream river basins; conditionally develop feasibility studies for Orkhon-Gobi and Shuren hydropower plants for hydropower generation and flow transfer from the Selenge and Orkhon River Basins to the Gobi region; conditionally establish water accumulation zones in low-evaporation areas in specified river basins, address water supply issues along these rivers, restore and protect ecosystems of specified lakes and associated wetlands, and develop infrastructure and capacity to regulate lake water regimes.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water sector; river headwaters; groundwater systems; glaciers, lakes, reservoirs, wetlands, upstream river basins, endorheic lakes, humid and sub-humid zones, cool and moderately humid zones, arid and semi-arid regions, and riparian forest areas.",
"Target Audience": "Local governments, the private sector, the mining industry, light and heavy industry.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved resilience of the water sector; conservation, restoration and sustainable use of water resources; secure water availability; improved assessment, monitoring, databases, reporting, and hydrological data acquisition; replenishment of groundwater resources; improved water access for wildlife, livestock, pasture irrigation, and household water use; restoration and protection of lake, wetland, and aquatic ecosystems; regulation of water thermal regimes; and support for breeding of native fish species."
NDC_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "Protect natural forests, improve forest health, and enhance forest regeneration capacity",
"Action/Intervention": "Expand forest protection zones and increase climate-resilient forest resources; improve forest structure and condition through implementation of forest maintenance and cleaning measures; enhance measures to control forest diseases and harmful insects; strengthen the forest fire prevention system",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Natural forests and forest ecosystems",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Protected natural forests, improved forest health, enhanced forest regeneration capacity, improved forest structure and condition, increased climate-resilient forest resources, better control of forest diseases and harmful insects, and a strengthened forest fire prevention system"
NDC_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "Expand the scope of afforestation and forest restoration through advanced technologies and innovation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support and implement public and private sector initiatives to localize and introduce advanced technologies and innovations in afforestation; implement optimal irrigation technologies and management solutions for afforestation; build forest seed banks maintaining genetic diversity and enhance tree species variety.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Afforestation and forest restoration.",
"Target Audience": "Public and private sector initiatives.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Expanded afforestation and forest restoration; maintained genetic diversity; enhanced tree species variety."
NDC_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve forest ecosystem protection through the establishment of a legal framework for sustainable forest management.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a legal framework for sustainable forest management; strengthen forest sector policies and strategies in alignment with climate change adaptation while enhancing legal frameworks and forest protection standards; improve forest resource management through advanced planning and monitoring systems; strengthen the capacity of professional forestry organizations; improve sustainable management for the protection and rational use of forest byproducts; establish and implement a comprehensive payment mechanism for forest ecosystem services.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Forests; forest ecosystem protection; forest sector.",
"Target Audience": "Forest sector institutions and professional forestry organizations.",

NDC_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "Enhance the legal and regulatory framework related to disaster risk reduction.",
"Action/Intervention": "Strengthen forest sector policies and strategies in alignment with climate change adaptation, while enhancing legal frameworks and forest protection standards; improve forest resource management through advanced planning and monitoring systems; strengthen the capacity of professional forestry organizations; improve sustainable management for the protection and rational use of forest byproducts; establish and implement a comprehensive payment mechanism for forest ecosystem services.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Forest sector; disaster risk reduction; climate change adaptation.",

NDC_9:
{
  "Goal/Purpose": "Strengthen early warning systems and reduce disaster risks at all levels.",
  "Action/Intervention": "Establish and maintain a centralized disaster risk information platform and database; improve impact-based forecasting tools and supercomputer technology; expand public access to forecasts; enhance flood early warning observation networks by adding 10 new hydrology monitoring stations; introduce an integrated emergency alert system capable of disseminating early warnings to the public in real time; implement a city level and nationwide rapid alert system to ensure timely delivery of early warnings to the public; establish a national weather radar network; develop a strategy and master plan for flood protection infrastructure and monitor its implementation in major cities.",

NDC_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce pasture pressure by raising young livestock using advanced methods and technologies, developing biosecure compartment farming, and supplying meat to target markets.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support private sector initiatives to raise young livestock using advanced methods and technologies for meat production; develop protected farms aimed at preparing meat for target markets and implement traceability technology; develop and implement response strategies for new and re-emerging livestock and animal infectious diseases; provide financial and land support to farmers engaged in intensive young livestock breeding and biosecure compartment livestock farming.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock farming and meat production.",
"Target Audience": "Private sector initiatives; farmers engaged in intensive young livestock breeding and biosecure compartment livestock farming.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced pasture pressure; development of biosecure compartment farming and protected farms; improved traceability in meat preparation for target markets; strengthened response to new and re-emerging livestock and animal infectious diseases; increased meat supply to target markets."
NDC_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "To improve livestock water and feed supply, quality and management in order to strengthen resilience against natural risks.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase pasture well supply based on exploration surveys and improve usage and protection management; develop small-scale water collection facilities such as reservoirs, ponds, and pools utilizing excess snow and rainwater; improve the demand and supply of livestock feed production and support herders' initiatives to grow fodder crops in winter-spring camps; implement supplementary feeding systems adapted to livestock nutritional requirements and weather conditions; establish mandatory hay and feed reserves for herder households and implement them in conjunction with incentive mechanisms; conditionally develop wholesale trade and warehouse operations through herders' cooperatives in provinces and soums where hay and feed preparation is not possible.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock sector; pasture and livestock water and feed management.",
"Target Audience": "Herders, herder households, and herders' cooperatives.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Strengthened resilience of livestock systems against natural risks through improved water and feed supply, quality, management, storage, and access."
NDC_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "Introduce smart technologies in livestock production and pasture utilization.",
"Action/Intervention": "Test and implement smart livestock movement monitoring systems and smart pasture management practices; create and implement a mobile app that provides herders with weather and market information; conduct extension training services among herders and farmers on smart technologies for livestock production and pasture utilization; strengthen technical and technological capacity for remote sensing monitoring of pasture conditions; train specialists and implement international projects in smart technologies for livestock production and pasture utilization.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock production and pasture utilization.",
"Target Audience": "Herders, farmers, and specialists.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Implementation of smart livestock movement monitoring systems, smart pasture management practices, a mobile app providing weather and market information to herders, extension training on smart technologies, strengthened remote sensing monitoring capacity for pasture conditions, and trained specialists through international projects."
NDC_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish sustainable and rational collaborative management practices for pastures and expand the scope of pasture restoration.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improve legal regulations regarding rights and responsibilities of stakeholders in pasture use and protection; secure and implement long-term contractual pasture use rights for primary herder household associations; incorporate collaborative pasture management into soum-level mid-term land management plans and enforce sustainable pasture use standards and certification; establish and implement financial mechanisms for sustainable pasture management; introduce and expand the scope of pasture restoration technologies and innovations.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Pastures; pasture use, protection, management, and restoration.",
"Target Audience": "Stakeholders in pasture use and protection; primary herder household associations; soum-level land management planners.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Sustainable and rational collaborative pasture management practices are established, and the scope of pasture restoration is expanded."
NDC_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "Conserve soil fertility and minimize moisture loss through expanded adoption of minimal and zero tillage technologies.",
"Action/Intervention": "Expand the adoption of minimal and zero tillage technologies across grain, fodder, and industrial crop production systems; expand the application of selective herbicides to support zero tillage farming practices; conduct extension training on machinery and technology among farmers; offer financial incentives to farmers adopting minimal and zero tillage agricultural practices; enhance the availability of smart-controlled machinery and equipment capable of performing multiple operations simultaneously in a single pass; implement fencing measures to protect crop stalks and straw in zero-tillage fields from livestock.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Grain, fodder, and industrial crop production systems.",
"Target Audience": "Farmers.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Expanded adoption of minimal and zero tillage technologies, with conserved soil fertility and reduced moisture loss in grain, fodder, and industrial crop production systems."
NDC_15:
{
  "Goal/Purpose": "Ensure consistent, sustainable high yields in crop production systems by integrating cutting-edge climate-smart technologies.",
  "Action/Intervention": "Integrate climate-smart technologies into crop production systems; establish forest strip infrastructure for irrigation and seedling production while expanding forested areas through cultivation of economically valuable tree species (pine nut, bird cherry, sea buckthorn, etc.); promote wider adoption of plastic film mulching and precision drip irrigation systems across irrigated potato and vegetable fields, greenhouses, and fruit and berry production areas; implement integrated snow and rainwater harvesting systems to enhance agricultural irrigation capacity; conditionally establish and operate inter-soums service units for cloud seeding and artificial rain enhancement in crop-growing regions.",
  "Ecosystem/Area": "Crop production systems; irrigated potato and vegetable fields; greenhouses; fruit and berry production areas; crop-growing regions.",
  "Target Audience": "Implementers in crop-growing regions, including those managing irrigated potato and vegetable fields, greenhouses, fruit and berry production areas, and inter-soums service units.",
  "Expected Impact/Outcome": "Consistent, sustainable high yields and enhanced agricultural irrigation capacity."
}
NDC_16:
{
  "Goal/Purpose": "Introduce and adapt crop varieties that are resistant to drought, disease, and pests.",
  "Action/Intervention": "Increase the planting area of locally-adapted, resilient crop varieties suitable for regional conditions; implement programs to breed, localize, and improve the supply of climate-resilient crop varieties; establish seed banks for climate-adapted varieties.",
  "Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture / crop production",
  "Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified",

NDC_18:
"Goal/Purpose": "Strengthen the health care system for early detection, warning, and response to climate change related threats to human health.",
"Action/Intervention": "Enhance institutional capacity for early detection, warning, response, and mitigation of climate change related health threats; expand data collection and research on climate change-related diseases; develop surveillance, information management, and early warning systems; develop climate resilient and environmentally sustainable health care infrastructure and increase investment in these facilities; raise public awareness and understanding of the impacts of climate change on human health; promote health preserving habits and behaviors across population.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Health care system; human health; climate change-related health threats.",
"Target Audience": "Health care system institutions; population.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved early detection, warning, response, and mitigation of climate change related health threats; expanded data collection and research on climate change-related diseases; operational surveillance, information management, and early warning systems; more climate resilient and environmentally sustainable health care infrastructure with increased investment; increased public awareness and understanding of climate change impacts on human health; greater promotion of health preserving habits and behaviors across population."
NDC_19:
"Goal/Purpose": "Identify groups most vulnerable to climate change and enhance their resilience, while strengthening welfare, protection, insurance, and prevention systems to address vulnerabilities and diversify the economic activities of citizens to ensure sustainable livelihoods.",
"Action/Intervention": "Identify groups vulnerable to climate change; implement women- and men-sensitive policies to empower households and individuals exposed or vulnerable to climate change and prevent risks; strengthen child protection systems to prevent, prepare for, and respond to the impacts of climate change; establish welfare, protection, insurance, and preventive systems to reduce vulnerability through identification and capacity building of groups vulnerable to climate change impacts and increasing their income; diversify the economic activities of citizens.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate change vulnerability, social welfare and protection, insurance, child protection, and livelihoods.",
"Target Audience": "Groups most vulnerable to climate change, including households and individuals exposed or vulnerable to climate change, children, and citizens.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Enhanced resilience of vulnerable groups to climate change, strengthened welfare, protection, insurance, and prevention systems, reduced vulnerability to climate change impacts, increased income of vulnerable groups, and more sustainable livelihoods through diversified economic activities."
NDC_20:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase climate education, green skills, and public participation, while ensuring the implementation of UNFCCC, Article 12 of the Paris Agreement, and the UNFCCC Action for Climate Empowerment (ACE) framework.",
"Action/Intervention": "Integrate climate change content into all levels of curricula and strengthen universal climate education; develop a workforce equipped with climate change knowledge and green skills; foster public knowledge, attitudes, and behaviors that enable adaptation to and coping with climate change; promote public participation and leadership in climate change action, with a focus on children, adolescents, and youth; expand public access to information and establish knowledge-sharing platforms; ensure implementation of UNFCCC, Article 12 of the Paris Agreement, and the UNFCCC Action for Climate Empowerment (ACE) framework.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate education, workforce skills development, public awareness, and public participation in climate change action.",
"Target Audience": "Workforce; the public; children, adolescents, and youth.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Strengthened climate education at all levels; a workforce with climate change knowledge and green skills; improved public knowledge, attitudes, and behaviors for adaptation and coping with climate change; increased public participation and leadership in climate change action; expanded public access to information and knowledge-sharing platforms; implementation of UNFCCC, Article 12 of the Paris Agreement, and the UNFCCC Action for Climate Empowerment (ACE) framework."
NDC_21:

"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A system is established to protect cultural heritage and traditional knowledge, with cultural heritage at risk from climate change safeguarded, traditional knowledge preserved, and their adaptation to climate change ensured."
