NDC_26:
"Goal/Purpose": "Ensure the inclusion of all social groups—including men, women, persons with disabilities, vulnerable communities, youth, and the elderly—in climate actions, while adhering to the core principles of gender-responsive climate budgeting",
"Action/Intervention": "Promote the full, equal and meaningful participation of diverse social groups, including women, youth and differently abled people, at all levels of climate-related decision-making processes; strengthen the skills of relevant decision-makers and officials in gender-responsive climate budgeting and allocate dedicated funding to support gender-inclusive climate initiatives that promote gender equality and women’s empowerment; establish mechanisms to collect sex-disaggregated data and develop national gender and climate change indicators and tools across all levels of climate action implementation to support evidence-based and inclusive policymaking",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate action and climate-related decision-making, budgeting, and implementation",
"Target Audience": "Men, women, persons with disabilities, vulnerable communities, youth, the elderly, relevant decision-makers, and officials",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Full, equal and meaningful participation of diverse social groups in climate-related decision-making; improved capacity of decision-makers and officials in gender-responsive climate budgeting; dedicated funding for gender-inclusive climate initiatives; availability of sex-disaggregated data and national gender and climate change indicators and tools to support evidence-based and inclusive policymaking"
NDC_27:
"Goal/Purpose": "Ensure that all climate change mitigation and adaptation actions are gender-responsive by explicitly respecting, promoting, and considering gender equality and the empowerment of women, in line with the Paris Agreement, particularly Article 7.5 on gender-responsive adaptation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Integrate gender equality into all climate policy, programme, and project cycles, including design, implementation, and evaluation stages; conduct gender assessments using national gender indicators and tools to track progress on gender equality within climate policies and programmes; provide capacity development training for policymakers, planners, and implementers on gender-responsive climate action; support women's leadership and capacity in climate-related sectors, especially in local and vulnerable communities; explicitly respect, promote, and consider gender equality and the empowerment of women in climate change mitigation and adaptation actions.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate change mitigation and adaptation actions; climate policy, programmes, and projects; climate-related sectors.",
"Target Audience": "Policymakers, planners, implementers, and women in climate-related sectors, especially in local and vulnerable communities.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "All climate change mitigation and adaptation actions are gender-responsive, with gender equality integrated across climate policy, programme, and project cycles, progress tracked through gender assessments and indicators, strengthened capacity for gender-responsive climate action, and enhanced women's leadership and capacity in climate-related sectors."
SECTORAL_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish a regionally differentiated land payment system and limit livestock numbers to match pasture carrying capacity, in order to balance grazing pressure across ecological zones.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a regionally differentiated land payment system; limit livestock numbers to match pasture carrying capacity; introduce Responsible Nomad good practice standards (MNS 6891:2020) and conduct compliance certification; implement livestock head tax legislation to incentivize herd size management; develop provincial pasture use and protection rules; train herders in carrying capacity-aligned grazing practices.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Pastureland across ecological zones.",
"Target Audience": "Herders; provincial authorities responsible for pasture use and protection rules; entities responsible for implementing compliance certification and livestock head tax legislation.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Livestock numbers aligned with pasture carrying capacity, grazing pressure balanced across ecological zones, and herd size management and grazing practices guided by standards, rules, certification, taxation, and training."
SECTORAL_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "Transform agriculture into an environmentally friendly, climate-change adapted, risk-resilient, socially responsive, responsible, highly productive, and sustainable leading economic sector.",
"Action/Intervention": "Enact law on reducing adverse climate change effects on traditional livestock husbandry; launch a nationwide New Cooperative movement to strengthen herder livelihoods; establish climate-adapted agricultural zones in central provinces; develop green economy-oriented production and sustainable resource use across the sector.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture sector, including traditional livestock husbandry and agricultural zones in central provinces.",
"Target Audience": "Agriculture sector stakeholders, including herders.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "An environmentally friendly, climate-change adapted, risk-resilient, socially responsive, responsible, highly productive, and sustainable agriculture sector serving as a leading economic sector; strengthened herder livelihoods; reduced adverse climate change effects on traditional livestock husbandry; climate-adapted agricultural zones established; green economy-oriented production and sustainable resource use developed across the sector."
SECTORAL_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Strengthen capacity for climate adaptation and risk reduction in agriculture, improve agricultural insurance systems, and reduce economic losses from sudden climate-related disasters.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improve indexed livestock insurance through revised loss thresholds and broader coverage; develop crop insurance legislation; provide restocking support for herders who lost 50% or more of livestock to climate disasters; implement the ECCO-FARM climate adaptation project across five provinces.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture; agricultural insurance; climate adaptation and disaster risk reduction.",
"Target Audience": "Herders who lost 50% or more of livestock to climate disasters; agricultural stakeholders covered by livestock and crop insurance systems; provinces implementing the ECCO-FARM climate adaptation project.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved capacity for climate adaptation and risk reduction in agriculture, improved agricultural insurance systems, and reduced economic losses from sudden climate-related disasters."
SECTORAL_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish a clear legal framework for pasture use, improvement, and protection, and create a unified pasture management system to reduce pasture degradation and desertification.",
"Action/Intervention": "Pass a Herder Primary Union legal status law enabling seasonal pasture contracts; establish a 4-season pasture use contract system for herder unions; require herders to follow 3 packages of good practices including pasture management; develop pasture management plans aligned with soum land-use plans.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Pasture management and pasture land use.",
"Target Audience": "Herder unions and herders.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A clear legal framework and unified pasture management system are in place, with reduced pasture degradation and desertification."
SECTORAL_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "Align livestock numbers, types, and composition with ecology and pasture carrying capacity, combat pasture pests and rodents, and increase pasture, fodder, and water supply to reduce agricultural risks.",
"Action/Intervention": "Set upper limits on livestock numbers, types, and composition; set annual overwintering livestock limits based on carrying capacity assessments; conduct pasture pest control on 650,000 to 1,000,000 ha annually; drill 100-200 deep wells and 400-500 simple wells annually for pasture water supply; designate approximately 3 million ha of reserve pasture zones; produce and distribute improved fodder crop seeds.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Pasture and livestock agriculture.",
"Target Audience": "Livestock and agricultural sector stakeholders.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Livestock limits aligned with carrying capacity, pasture pests and rodents controlled, increased pasture reserve area, expanded pasture water supply through wells, improved fodder seed availability, and reduced agricultural risks."
SECTORAL_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "Develop green economy-oriented livestock husbandry that preserves traditional nomadic cultural heritage in rangelands while establishing intensified, technology-driven farming near urban areas, sustainably using resources.",
"Action/Intervention": "Maintain traditional nomadic rangeland-based herding as the dominant pastoral system; establish intensified meat and dairy farming zones near Darkhan-Uul, Selenge, and Tuv provinces; direct cooperative investment loans toward 14 climate adaptation measures; promote sustainable resource use through herder cooperatives.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock husbandry in rangelands and urban-adjacent farming areas, including meat and dairy farming zones near Darkhan-Uul, Selenge, and Tuv provinces.",
"Target Audience": "Nomadic herders, herder cooperatives, and meat and dairy farming actors in Darkhan-Uul, Selenge, and Tuv provinces.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Traditional nomadic herding is preserved in rangelands; intensified, technology-driven meat and dairy farming zones are established near urban areas; cooperative investment loans support 14 climate adaptation measures; resource use is made more sustainable through herder cooperatives."
SECTORAL_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase the competitiveness and value of Mongolian crops grown in fertile soils, and increase agricultural exports, through the development of smart technology-based agriculture.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop smart technology-based agriculture; introduce precision agriculture and smart farming technologies; improve soil fertility through fallow management and soil enrichment; support crop seed quality improvement and certification; expand export-oriented crop production.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture; fertile soils; crop production.",
"Target Audience": "Agricultural sector involved in Mongolian crop production and export.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "More competitive and higher-value Mongolian crops grown in fertile soils, and increased agricultural exports."
SECTORAL_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "Expand irrigated agricultural production capacity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Invest in modern irrigation infrastructure; install modern irrigation equipment across agricultural enterprises; bring fallow and abandoned cropland back into irrigated rotation and efficient cultivation; replace traditional tillage with water-efficient agrotechnical methods; improve fallow preparation using chemical and combined approaches.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture; irrigated cropland.",
"Target Audience": "Agricultural enterprises.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased irrigated agricultural production capacity; fallow and abandoned cropland brought back into irrigated rotation; adoption of modern irrigation equipment and water-efficient agrotechnical methods."
SECTORAL_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase sustainable resource utilization through cooperative initiatives, eco-initiatives, and investment in agriculture.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish herder cooperatives as primary units for sustainable resource management; channel cooperative investment loans toward climate change adaptation activities; promote eco-friendly and sustainable production practices through cooperative networks.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture; sustainable resource management.",
"Target Audience": "Herder cooperatives; cooperative networks; agriculture sector stakeholders.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased sustainable resource utilization; strengthened sustainable resource management through herder cooperatives; greater investment in climate change adaptation activities; wider adoption of eco-friendly and sustainable production practices."
SECTORAL_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "Expand state specially protected areas to cover 30% of national territory by 2030, 33% by 2040, and 35% by 2050, while ensuring representation of major ecosystem types and freshwater source areas.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct studies to identify freshwater, forest, and biodiversity-important areas for protection; expand the state specially protected areas network from 20.1% to 30% by 2030; increase protected river source areas from 48.3% to 60% by 2030 and 75% by 2050; increase protected forest area from 39.1% to 50% by 2030 and 60% by 2050; ensure protected area expansion includes major ecosystem types and freshwater source areas.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "National territory, including major ecosystem types, freshwater source areas, river source areas, forests, and biodiversity-important areas.",
"Target Audience": "State authorities responsible for specially protected areas management and protection.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "State specially protected areas cover 30% of national territory by 2030, 33% by 2040, and 35% by 2050; protected river source areas increase from 48.3% to 60% by 2030 and 75% by 2050; protected forest area increases from 39.1% to 50% by 2030 and 60% by 2050; major ecosystem types and freshwater source areas are represented within the protected areas network."
SECTORAL_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase forest cover to 9% of national territory and increase carbon dioxide sequestration.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct reforestation and afforestation programmes; support natural forest regeneration and expansion; strengthen forest protection measures against fire, illegal logging, and pest outbreaks; establish forest agroparks to reduce direct harvesting pressure.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Forests / national territory",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target or associated implementation activities.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Forest cover reaches 9% of national territory; increased carbon dioxide sequestration; reduced direct harvesting pressure; strengthened protection against fire, illegal logging, and pest outbreaks."
SECTORAL_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "Protect soil, reduce land degradation, and combat desertification through a national programme.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement a national programme; protect soil fertility and moisture to prevent land degradation; prevent and reverse desertification in affected zones; restore degraded and contaminated land and return it to productive use; develop smart environmental monitoring systems for land condition.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Soil and land, including affected zones subject to desertification and degraded or contaminated land.",
"Target Audience": "National-level implementers and areas affected by land degradation, desertification, and land contamination.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Protected soil fertility and moisture; reduced land degradation; prevented and reversed desertification in affected zones; restored degraded and contaminated land returned to productive use; improved monitoring of land condition."
SECTORAL_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "Rehabilitate land degraded by mining, agriculture, infrastructure, and urban development, increase user accountability, and restore land for productive reuse.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement the Green Belt project; rehabilitate land degraded by mining operations; restore agricultural land damaged by overuse and erosion; reclaim areas affected by infrastructure and urban development; increase land user accountability for environmental restoration.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Land degraded by mining, agriculture, infrastructure, and urban development.",
"Target Audience": "Land users.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Degraded land is rehabilitated and restored for productive reuse, with increased user accountability for environmental restoration."
SECTORAL_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve the regulatory framework for valuing ecosystem services, update ecological-economic assessments, and raise public awareness of ecosystem service values and benefits.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop and improve regulations for ecosystem service valuation; update ecological-economic assessments of natural resources; communicate ecosystem service values and benefits to the public; integrate ecosystem service valuation into policy and planning decisions.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Ecosystem services and natural resources.",
"Target Audience": "Policymakers and planning authorities, the public.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "An improved regulatory framework for ecosystem service valuation, updated ecological-economic assessments, increased public awareness of ecosystem service values and benefits, and integration of ecosystem service valuation into policy and planning decisions."
SECTORAL_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce subsidies to economic activities that negatively affect ecosystems and biodiversity, and support ecosystem conservation and protection activities.",
"Action/Intervention": "Identify and assess subsidies that negatively impact ecosystems and biodiversity; phase down harmful subsidies in agriculture, mining, and other sectors; redirect financial support toward ecosystem conservation and protection; develop science-based professional education for environmental conservation.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Ecosystems and biodiversity; agriculture, mining, and other sectors linked to harmful subsidies; ecosystem conservation and protection.",
"Target Audience": "Actors responsible for subsidy assessment, reform, and financial support redirection in agriculture, mining, and other sectors; professionals receiving science-based education for environmental conservation.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced subsidies for economic activities that negatively affect ecosystems and biodiversity, increased financial support for ecosystem conservation and protection activities, and strengthened professional education for environmental conservation."
FSS_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "To establish a legal framework for ensuring food supply and safety, reduce the country's reliance on imported food raw materials and products through tariff regulation, and create a legal environment to increase the variety and volume of export-oriented food and agricultural products.",
"Action/Intervention": "Draft legislation and submit it to the State Great Khural during the 2022 autumn and 2023 spring ordinary sessions and by 2022, including: drafting the Law on Agriculture; developing a draft law and related regulations on food with regulatory functions; drafting and submitting amendments to the Law on Food; drafting and submitting amendments to the Law on Food Product Safety; drafting and submitting a revised Law on Plant Protection; drafting and submitting a bill on Agricultural Insurance; drafting and submitting amendments to the 1999 State Great Khural Resolution No. 27; drafting and submitting amendments to the Law on Standardisation, Technical Regulation and Conformity Assessment Accreditation; drafting and submitting amendments to the Law on the Procedure for Implementing the Law Prohibiting the Exploration and Exploitation of Mineral Resources in Headwater Areas of Rivers, Watersheds, Protected Water Sources, and Forested Areas; and introducing tariff regulation to reduce reliance on imported food raw materials and products and support export-oriented food and agricultural products.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food supply and safety, agriculture, food products, plant protection, agricultural insurance, standardisation and technical regulation, and legal regulation affecting protected headwaters, watersheds, protected water sources, and forested areas.",
"Target Audience": "The State Great Khural.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Submission of the specified draft laws and amendments to the State Great Khural within the stated timeframes; establishment of a legal framework for food supply and safety; reduced reliance on imported food raw materials and products through tariff regulation; and an improved legal environment to increase the variety and volume of export-oriented food and agricultural products."
FSS_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "To establish an optimal system for the provision of meals and food for children through amendments to relevant legislation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Draft and submit to the State Great Khural a bill to amend the relevant legislation; draft and submit a bill to amend the Law on State Control and Inspection; draft and submit a bill to amend the Law on Food Production and Service in General Education Schools; establish a legal framework to include food operators in short-term professional training on food safety; establish a legal and regulatory framework and system for classifying, monitoring, certifying and ensuring transparency in food production and service establishments.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Child meals and food provision; food production and service in general education schools; food safety regulation and inspection.",
"Target Audience": "State Great Khural; food operators; food production and service establishments; general education schools; children.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Submission of legislative amendments and establishment of legal and regulatory frameworks and systems for food safety training, classification, monitoring, certification, and transparency in food production and service establishments related to meals and food for children."
FSS_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "To revise and approve the methodology for calculating food safety statistical indicators and to ensure that food-related standards, technical regulations, and guidance documents on good practices are analysed, evaluated, updated, or newly adopted for each stage of the food chain.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop and update the methodology for calculating food safety statistical indicators; conduct an analysis and evaluation of all food-related standards; update and approve, as necessary, relevant standards, technical regulations, and guidance documents on good practices for each stage of the food chain; revise and newly approve good practice recommendations and guidelines for each stage of the food chain; develop technical regulations for major food products.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food safety and the food chain.",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for developing, approving, and implementing food safety methodologies, standards, technical regulations, and good practice guidance across the food chain.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A revised and approved methodology for food safety statistical indicators, and updated or newly adopted food-related standards, technical regulations, and guidance documents on good practices for each stage of the food chain."
FSS_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "To establish an approved procedure for tracing the origin of raw materials and products of animal origin, as well as plant and plant-derived food, through to the final product, and to integrate this procedure into the unified electronic registration system.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop and approve the registration procedure and regulations concerning traceability records for raw materials and products of animal and plant origin from their origin through to the final product, and transfer/migrate these records and procedures to the unified electronic registration system.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Animal-origin and plant-origin raw materials and food product traceability within the electronic registration system.",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for developing, approving, maintaining, and using traceability records and the unified electronic registration system for animal- and plant-origin raw materials and products.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "An approved traceability registration procedure and regulations are in place, and traceability records for relevant raw materials and products are transferred to the unified electronic registration system."
FSS_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish an approved regulatory framework for the establishment and utilisation of seasonal food reserves.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop and approve regulations on the establishment and utilisation of seasonal food reserves.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food reserves / food security regulation",
"Target Audience": "Authorities responsible for developing and approving regulations on seasonal food reserves",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Regulations on the establishment and utilisation of seasonal food reserves are developed and approved."
FSS_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "To determine food safety indicators and establish control of contamination in food.",
"Action/Intervention": "Define food safety indicators; monitor pesticide residues, veterinary drug residues, heavy metal residues, and high-toxicity bacteria/microorganisms; and approve the control plan.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food safety",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Food safety indicators are determined, contamination by pesticides, veterinary drugs, heavy metals, and high-toxicity bacteria/microorganisms is monitored, and the control plan is approved."
FSS_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "To study and resolve the issue of establishing a Food Science and Research Institute.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase funding for commissioned research and experimental work by the research institute to introduce scientific advances into the food and agriculture sectors and boost production levels; establish the legal framework for the creation of a Food Science and Research Institute and resolve other related issues.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food and agriculture sectors; food science and research.",
"Target Audience": "Research institute; food and agriculture sectors.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Creation of the legal framework for a Food Science and Research Institute; increased funding for commissioned research and experimental work; introduction of scientific advances into the food and agriculture sectors; boosted production levels."
FSS_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "To enforce compliance with standard and technical regulation requirements in food-related activities across every stage of the food chain, implement good practices, establish a control and management system, and increase the number of accredited bodies authorised to certify it.",
"Action/Intervention": "Enforce compliance with standard and technical regulation requirements in livestock farming, crop cultivation, food production, storage, transport, trade, food service and catering; implement good practices in agriculture, hygiene, production, transport, storage, trade, service and food production at every stage of the food chain; implement a control and management system; and increase the number of accredited certification bodies authorised to certify it.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock farming, crop cultivation, food production, storage, transport, trade, food service, catering, and the food chain.",
"Target Audience": "Actors involved in livestock farming, crop cultivation, food production, storage, transport, trade, food service and catering, as well as accredited certification bodies.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Compliance with standard and technical regulation requirements is enforced across the food chain, good practices are implemented in food-related activities, a control and management system is in place, and the number of accredited bodies authorised to provide certification is increased."
FSS_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "To enhance internal controls to ensure that safety requirements for raw materials, products, and their production and supply are fully met, and to refine the external monitoring system by intensifying control activities.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improve and enforce the internal control system for ensuring that safety standards are fully met during the production and supply of food raw materials and products; refine the external audit system; intensify audit and control operations.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food raw materials and products production and supply; safety control and monitoring systems.",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for the production and supply of food raw materials and products, and bodies responsible for internal control and external audit/monitoring.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved internal control and external monitoring systems, with intensified audit and control activities to ensure that safety requirements and standards are fully met."
FSS_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "To restructure state-owned universities and professional-vocational training centres in the fields of food, agriculture and light industry, improve the quality of training, support students in priority areas, enhance the skills of qualified professionals, create stable working conditions for professional personnel, and ensure necessary funding is included in national and local budgets.",
"Action/Intervention": "Reform the structure and organisation of relevant state-owned universities and colleges; modernise their organisational structure; improve the quality of training for staff in the food, agriculture and light industry sectors; provide tuition fee support for students in these sectors' priority areas; enhance the skills of qualified professionals; create stable working conditions for professional personnel; include necessary funding in national and local budgets; and require operators of food-related activities to provide general guidance on food safety and arrange refresher training for staff.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "State-owned universities and professional-vocational training centres in the food, agriculture and light industry sectors, including food-related activities.",
"Target Audience": "State-owned universities, professional-vocational training centres, students in priority areas of food, agriculture and light industry, qualified professionals, staff in these sectors, and operators of food-related activities.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Restructured and modernised relevant universities and training centres, improved training quality, tuition fee support provided to students in priority areas, enhanced skills of qualified professionals and staff, stable working conditions for professional personnel, food safety guidance and refresher training organised for staff, and necessary funding allocated in national and local budgets."
FSS_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "To ensure a stable supply of the infrastructure, energy, steam, heat and fuel sources required to guarantee food supply and safety and to increase domestic production of food products that replace imports.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish regulations to reduce or exempt the costs of steam and heat usage for major food producers and greenhouse farms; organise measures to ensure the stable supply of fuel and energy in order to maintain the continuity of agricultural production; where necessary, establish and implement arrangements to subsidise or exempt the electricity costs of staple food producers.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food production and agricultural production, including greenhouse farming and staple food production.",
"Target Audience": "Major food producers, greenhouse farms, staple food producers, and agricultural producers.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Stable supply of infrastructure, energy, steam, heat and fuel for food production; continuity of agricultural production; guaranteed food supply and safety; increased domestic production of food products that replace imports."
FSS_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "To revive, promote and introduce traditional food preparation methods and technologies, adapted to the unique natural, geographical and climatic characteristics of Mongolia, into everyday use, and to establish and support a system for creating innovative products based on traditional food preparation knowledge.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organise research and analysis to revive and introduce traditional food preparation methods and technologies adapted to the natural, geographical and climatic characteristics of Mongolia; support the creation of branded products by developing distinctive goods using traditional Mongolian technologies; establish a national Mongolian food and beverage network; establish and support a system for creating innovative products based on traditional food preparation knowledge.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food preparation, food and beverage sector, and traditional knowledge in Mongolia.",
"Target Audience": "Implementing institutions involved in research, product development, and food and beverage network establishment, and users of traditional food preparation methods and products in everyday use.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Traditional food preparation methods and technologies are revived, promoted, and introduced into everyday use; a system for creating innovative products based on traditional food preparation knowledge is established and supported; branded and distinctive goods using traditional Mongolian technologies are created; and a national Mongolian food and beverage network is established."
FSS_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "To support citizens and businesses that have relocated from the capital to rural areas to engage in livestock farming and agriculture, in order to ensure a balance between urban and rural development and to curb centralisation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support relocated citizens and businesses to engage in livestock farming and agriculture, including organising the provision of preferential loans from the Local Small and Medium Enterprises Development Fund to individuals and businesses engaged in food-related activities who have relocated from the capital to local areas.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Rural development, livestock farming, agriculture, and food-related small and medium enterprise development.",
"Target Audience": "Citizens, individuals, and businesses that have relocated from the capital to rural/local areas and are engaged in livestock farming, agriculture, or food-related activities.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased engagement of relocated citizens and businesses in livestock farming and agriculture, contributing to a balance between urban and rural development and helping to curb centralisation."
FSS_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "To create opportunities to introduce and promote domestically produced branded products at international and regional exhibitions and trade fairs, and to establish and support the legal framework for their export.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide opportunities to introduce and promote brand products manufactured in Mongolia at international and regional exhibitions and trade fairs; establish and support the legal framework for export of domestically produced branded products; select and reward the top 100 producers in the food and agriculture sector; promote and raise awareness of the ‘Food Supply and Safety’ national movement.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Domestic product promotion, export, and the food and agriculture sector.",
"Target Audience": "Producers of domestically manufactured branded products in Mongolia, particularly producers in the food and agriculture sector.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased promotion and visibility of domestically produced branded products at international and regional exhibitions and trade fairs, supported by a legal framework for their export."
FSS_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "To improve the use of agricultural land, increase plot sizes, bring the area under rotation to 1.1 million hectares, increase irrigated cropland by 5,000 hectares, and align agricultural land with the national land-use planning scheme.",
"Action/Intervention": "Convert up to 200,000 hectares of newly reclaimed land into agricultural land; update indicators of farmland status, soil fertility, erosion and degradation; convert virgin land into arable land based on a suitability study; increase the area of irrigated wheat cultivation by 5,000 hectares.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agricultural land, including newly reclaimed land, virgin land, arable land, irrigated cropland, and land covered by the national land-use planning scheme.",
"Target Audience": "Agricultural land managers and agricultural sector stakeholders.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Up to 200,000 hectares of newly reclaimed land converted into agricultural land; area under rotation increased to 1.1 million hectares; irrigated cropland increased by 5,000 hectares; agricultural land aligned with the national land-use planning scheme; updated indicators on farmland status, soil fertility, erosion and degradation."
FSS_16:
"Goal/Purpose": "Utilisation and protection of plant genetic resources; establishment of a seed reserve for locally adapted varieties; creation of a system for the production of seeds of cereals, potatoes, vegetables, fruits, berries and other useful crops; establishment at the national level of 15 seed farms; and development of variety testing activities on a scientific basis.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support the development of new crop varieties, their acclimatisation and testing, the production of elite certified seeds of these varieties, and the implementation of scientific and technological projects. Support the establishment of primary seed multiplication centres and threshing floors for wheat, potato, legume and fodder crops based on the Institute of Plant and Agricultural Sciences. Maintain a register of crop varieties and register seed, seedling and planting-stock producers and sellers for each crop, and establish an electronic database. Provide support for the establishment of seed farms for the production of grain and fodder crop seeds. Establish primary seed multiplication and variety testing centres to protect agricultural production from risks and to select crops and varieties suited to the region. Based on the activities of the Plant and Agricultural Environment Institute, establish at the national level four wheat, feed, 2 fodder, 5 vegetable, 4 potato, a total of 15 seed farms.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Plant genetic resources, seed production, crop variety testing, and agricultural production for cereals, potatoes, vegetables, fruits, berries and other useful crops.",
"Target Audience": "The Plant and Agricultural Environment Institute / Institute of Plant and Agricultural Sciences; seed, seedling and planting-stock producers and sellers; seed farms.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A seed reserve for locally adapted varieties is established; a national seed production system for cereals, potatoes, vegetables, fruits, berries and other useful crops is created; 15 seed farms are established at the national level; primary seed multiplication centres and variety testing centres are established; a crop variety register and electronic database are maintained; elite certified seeds of new varieties are produced; and variety testing activities are developed on a scientific basis."
FSS_17:
"Goal/Purpose": "Ensure that the system for agricultural production in Mongolia adheres to technological documentation, introduces advanced technologies that reduce soil degradation, protects and improves soil fertility, applies proper crop rotation, and carries out technical and technological modernisation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Adhere to technological documentation; introduce advanced technologies with soil degradation reduction, fertility protection and improvement, and proper crop rotation; carry out technical and technological modernisation; provide tax support for machinery and equipment used in grain production by exempting them from customs duties and deferring tax payments; grant a 50 per cent discount on machinery purchased in the same year to improve the mechanisation of potato and vegetable production and support technical and technological modernisation; provide support for the manufacture of small-scale equipment and working components.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agricultural production in Mongolia, including grain, potato, and vegetable production.",
"Target Audience": "Agricultural producers in Mongolia, including grain, potato, and vegetable producers, as well as manufacturers of small-scale equipment and working components.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Agricultural production systems that follow technological documentation, increased use of advanced technologies, reduced soil degradation, protected and improved soil fertility, proper crop rotation, improved mechanisation of potato and vegetable production, and technical and technological modernisation."
FSS_18:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase fodder cultivation and production, and raise the domestic supply of feed required for intensive livestock farming and auxiliary farms to 1.9 million tonnes through organisational and financial support.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide organisational and financial support to increase fodder cultivation and production; provide preferential working capital loans to feed mills for the purchase of domestic raw materials.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock farming, auxiliary farms, fodder cultivation and feed production.",
"Target Audience": "Feed mills, intensive livestock farming operations, and auxiliary farms.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Domestic supply of feed required for intensive livestock farming and auxiliary farms reaches 1.9 million tonnes."
FSS_19:
{
  "Goal/Purpose": "To expand greenhouse cultivation to 270 hectares and ensure a stable, year-round supply of fresh produce for the population.",
  "Action/Intervention": "Plan and implement policies and actions to expand greenhouse cultivation; establish a 50-hectare winter greenhouse complex in areas with adequate heating supply and infrastructure; establish a leasing system for the establishment of summer greenhouse farms; provide interest support; establish a 50-hectare greenhouse complex farm using advanced technology.",
  "Ecosystem/Area": "Greenhouse cultivation and fresh produce supply.",
  "Target Audience": "The population; entities responsible for establishing greenhouse farms and greenhouse complexes.",
  "Expected Impact/Outcome": "Greenhouse cultivation expanded to 270 hectares; establishment of a 50-hectare winter greenhouse complex and a 50-hectare greenhouse complex farm using advanced technology; a stable, year-round supply of fresh produce."
}
FSS_20:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop domestic fertiliser production to replenish soil nutrients and increase crop quality and yield, replace imports, and develop the technical and economic feasibility of establishing nitrogen and phosphorus fertiliser plants based on mining enterprises to support exports and ensure their implementation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Research the reserves of raw materials for nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium fertilisers based on mining deposits; develop the technical and economic feasibility for establishing fertiliser production plants, including nitrogen and phosphorus plants based on mining enterprises; establish and implement domestic fertiliser production; and provide fertiliser on preferential terms.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture, fertiliser production, and mining-based industrial development.",
"Target Audience": "Mining enterprises, fertiliser producers, and crop producers.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Replenished soil nutrients, increased crop quality and yield, replacement of fertiliser imports, support for exports, and implementation of nitrogen and phosphorus fertiliser plants."
FSS_21:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase the cultivation of all types of rice, sugar beet, and other cash crops, supported by financing, lending, and policy support systems.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the area of irrigated fields for the cultivation of all types of rice and sugar beet; establish an optimal system for financing and lending; provide policy support; focus on increasing the cultivation of rice, sugar beet, and other cash crops.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture, specifically irrigated crop cultivation and cash crop production.",
"Target Audience": "Producers and cultivators of rice, sugar beet, and other cash crops.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased area of irrigated fields for rice and sugar beet cultivation, and increased cultivation of rice, sugar beet, and other cash crops."
FSS_22:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase regional storage capacity for grain, potatoes, and vegetables by expanding facilities that meet standard requirements.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the capacity of grain elevators meeting standard requirements by 20,000 tonnes and increase the capacity of mechanised warehouses and cellars for storing potatoes and vegetables by 50,000 tonnes on a regional basis; establish fully automated, mechanised potato and vegetable storage facilities with capacities of 500–2,500 tonnes each in the capital city and the 21 provinces; construct grain elevators in the western and eastern agricultural regions.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agricultural storage infrastructure for grain, potatoes, and vegetables on a regional basis.",
"Target Audience": "Implementing authorities and operators of grain elevators, mechanised warehouses, cellars, and storage facilities in the capital city, the 21 provinces, and the western and eastern agricultural regions.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Capacity of grain elevators meeting standard requirements increased by 20,000 tonnes and capacity of mechanised warehouses and cellars for storing potatoes and vegetables increased by 50,000 tonnes, respectively, on a regional basis."
FSS_23:
"Goal/Purpose": "To overcome the risks of climate change.",
"Action/Intervention": "Introduce advanced, environmentally friendly irrigation technology that uses water properly; construct new irrigation systems; restore, renovate and refurbish irrigation systems; establish reservoirs, ponds and dams with basins; create the necessary financial resources and provide support for their construction; provide loans for equipment that enables the proper use and management of water by harvesting surface water, expanding irrigated vegetable plots and implementing technical and technological upgrades.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Irrigation and water management.",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for irrigation system construction and rehabilitation, and recipients of loans for water-use and irrigation equipment.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Proper use and management of water, harvesting of surface water, expanded irrigated vegetable plots, and technical and technological upgrades to irrigation systems."
FSS_24:
"Goal/Purpose": "Implement the ‘Billion Trees’ national movement through agroforestry establishment, fruit and berry seedling propagation, nursery enterprise development, and the creation of forest belts on agricultural fields.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish 30 hectares of agroforestry in the provincial centre and 10 hectares in the district centre; establish a fruit and berry seedling propagation centre; develop nursery enterprises; fence off agricultural fields to establish forest belts; establish forest belts on agricultural fields; establish specialised fruit and berry farms; create a financing and incentive system; expand research and analysis; develop cultivation technologies; establish local centres for the propagation of fruit and berry seedlings; establish agroforestry enterprises in provinces and municipalities.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agroforestry, agricultural fields, provincial and district centres, provinces and municipalities.",
"Target Audience": "Provinces, municipalities, provincial centres, district centres, nursery enterprises, agroforestry enterprises, and specialised fruit and berry farms.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "30 hectares of agroforestry established in the provincial centre; 10 hectares of agroforestry established in the district centre; a fruit and berry seedling propagation centre established; nursery enterprises developed; agricultural fields fenced off to establish forest belts; local seedling propagation centres and agroforestry enterprises established."
FSS_25:
"Goal/Purpose": "Build strategic reserves of at least 100,000 tonnes of food and seed red wheat from each year's autumn harvest.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organise the establishment of a strategic reserve of no less than 100,000 tonnes of food and seed red wheat from each year's autumn harvest and establish a working capital fund.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food and seed wheat reserves / agriculture",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target or associated implementation activity.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A strategic reserve of at least 100,000 tonnes of food and seed red wheat is established from each year's autumn harvest, with a working capital fund established."
FSS_26:
"Goal/Purpose": "To establish a proper ratio of livestock headcount to pasture capacity, protect animal health, increase the yield per animal, improve animal quality, and enhance the role and participation of herders.",
"Action/Intervention": "Collaborate with the administration and local authorities; segregate breeding and insemination stock and core herd sires and place them in a centralised location for expert supervision; determine livestock productivity indicators and establish an integrated database through inspections, classifications, individual tagging and registration, and genetic evaluations; determine and evaluate the status of livestock genetic resources and take remedial action; improve the utilisation and protection of pastures; and increase the reserves of grazing land, water, fodder and feed.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock and pasture management.",
"Target Audience": "Administration, local authorities, and herders.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A proper livestock-to-pasture ratio established; animal health protected; yield per animal increased; animal quality improved; herder role and participation enhanced; livestock productivity indicators and an integrated database established; livestock genetic resources evaluated and remedial action taken; and utilisation, protection, and reserves of pastures, grazing land, water, fodder, and feed improved."
FSS_27:
"Goal/Purpose": "Develop target markets for livestock and livestock raw materials, establish an optimal supply chain for procurement, primary processing and marketing, and establish and modernise model cooperatives while supporting the cooperative movement.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop target markets for livestock and livestock raw materials; establish an optimal supply chain for procurement, primary processing and marketing; establish and modernise model cooperatives; support the cooperative movement in all respects; establish model cooperatives for livestock, livestock products, supply, primary processing and sales; provide small-scale equipment required for household enterprises and sales support.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock sector, including livestock raw materials, procurement, primary processing, marketing, cooperatives, and household enterprises.",
"Target Audience": "Model cooperatives, the cooperative movement, and household enterprises involved in livestock, livestock products, supply, primary processing and sales.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Target markets are developed for livestock and livestock raw materials; an optimal supply chain for procurement, primary processing and marketing is established; model cooperatives are established and modernised; the cooperative movement is supported; and household enterprises receive small-scale equipment and sales support."
FSS_28:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop intensive livestock farming near towns and settlements and in agricultural regions; establish core breeding flocks for meat and fine-wool sheep; protect livestock gene pools; intensify breeding and technological work; support the operations of units in this field; and provide the necessary budget funding.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide support for intensive beef and dairy farms in urban, settlement and agricultural areas; provide loans and interest rate support to operators of intensive dairy farms; provide loans and interest support to operators of intensive meat-focused farms; support the establishment of core breeding flocks for meat and fine-wool sheep; import high-yield animal embryos from abroad under a unified policy; introduce biotechnological advances into breeding and selection work; protect livestock genetic resources; intensify breeding and technological work; support the operations of units in this field; and include the necessary funding in the budget.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock farming and animal breeding in urban, settlement, and agricultural areas.",
"Target Audience": "Operators of intensive dairy farms, operators of intensive meat-focused farms, units working in breeding and technological livestock activities, and sheep breeding operations establishing core breeding flocks for meat and fine-wool sheep.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Development of intensive livestock farming with 50.0 thousand head of beef-oriented breeds and 50.0 thousand head of dairy-oriented breeds; establishment of core breeding flocks for meat and fine-wool sheep; import of high-yield animal embryos from abroad under a unified policy; introduction of biotechnological advances into breeding and selection work; protection of livestock gene pools; intensified breeding and technological work; operational support for relevant units; and allocation of necessary budget funding."
FSS_29:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase enterprise participation in the expansion and establishment of pig, poultry, and fattening lamb and cattle farms through long-term investment and financial support.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide long-term investment and financial support; provide pig farmers with preferential loan support; provide tax support for the poultry industry by exempting equipment from customs duties and deferring tax payments; support and develop meat cattle and sheep fattening farms by increasing regional and local involvement.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock sector, specifically pig, poultry, lamb, sheep, and cattle farming.",
"Target Audience": "Enterprises participating in pig, poultry, and fattening lamb and cattle farms; pig farmers; poultry industry operators; meat cattle and sheep fattening farms; regional and local actors involved in support.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Expanded and newly established pig, poultry, and fattening lamb and cattle farms, with increased enterprise participation supported by investment, loans, tax support, and greater regional and local involvement."
FSS_30:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop beekeeping as a co-operative enterprise, increase its product output, and create opportunities for export.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organise beekeepers into clusters based on regionalisation and cooperation; support them through policy; develop them by leveraging the activities of professional associations; provide preferential loan support to phase out honey imports and increase exports of honey with geographical indications.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Beekeeping and honey production.",
"Target Audience": "Beekeepers, professional associations, and honey producers/exporters.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Beekeeping developed as a co-operative enterprise; increased product output; opportunities for export created; honey imports phased out; exports of honey with geographical indications increased."
FSS_31:
"Goal/Purpose": "To swiftly implement comprehensive measures to combat highly contagious diseases in livestock and animals.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement comprehensive measures to combat highly contagious/highly pathogenic diseases in livestock and animals; introduce advanced biopreparate production/technologies; expand and modernise the operations of ‘Biocombinat’ LLC; vaccinate all susceptible livestock and animals twice a year; establish a vaccine cold chain network; strengthen the veterinary diagnostic laboratory; strengthen the operations of veterinary service units; include the necessary funding in national and local budgets.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock and animal health; veterinary services.",
"Target Audience": "Veterinary service units, veterinary diagnostic laboratories, ‘Biocombinat’ LLC, national and local budget authorities, and livestock and animal populations susceptible to disease.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Strengthened capacity to prevent and combat highly contagious diseases in livestock and animals through improved vaccine production, vaccine storage and distribution, laboratory diagnostics, veterinary service operations, regular vaccination, and allocated funding."
FSS_32:
"Goal/Purpose": "To refine the incentive system for domestically processed products that meet domestic market quality, hygiene and safety standards, and for products manufactured from food raw materials supplied by livestock farming and agriculture.",
"Action/Intervention": "Process domestically the raw materials supplied by livestock farming and agriculture; manufacture finished products; award incentives for products sold on the domestic market that meet quality, hygiene and safety standards; establish and develop the legal framework and regulations for providing incentives to products that meet quality and safety standards; channel traceable, healthy livestock to abattoirs and raw milk to dairy processing plants; provide incentives and support to herders and intensive livestock farmers who supply eggs, pork and chicken meat.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock farming, agriculture, domestic food processing, abattoirs, dairy processing, and the domestic food market.",
"Target Audience": "Domestic processors of livestock and agricultural raw materials, products sold on the domestic market, herders, intensive livestock farmers, abattoirs, and dairy processing plants.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Domestically processed and finished products made from livestock farming and agricultural raw materials receive incentives when they meet domestic market quality, hygiene and safety standards; a legal and regulatory framework for such incentives is established; traceable, healthy livestock and raw milk are directed into formal processing channels; and support is provided to suppliers of eggs, pork and chicken meat."
FSS_33:
"Goal/Purpose": "To provide financial support for the establishment and expansion of new factories for children's food, milk, vegetables, fruits, and fruit-based feeds, and for the domestic procurement and supply of their primary raw materials.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide financial and preferential loan support for establishing and expanding factories for children's food and related products; establish a processing plant for vegetables, fruits and berries for children's meals and food consumption; provide preferential loan support for establishing a plant to process milk and dairy feed for children; provide support for establishing a ready-made, import-replacing product factory for children; provide preferential loan support for establishing a local milk processing plant for the production of curd, butter and milk for school and nursery children; support the domestic procurement and supply of primary raw materials.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food processing and manufacturing sector for children's food and dairy products.",
"Target Audience": "Factories and processing plants producing children's food, milk, vegetables, fruits, fruit-based feeds, and related raw material supply; school and nursery children.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Establishment and expansion of new factories and processing plants for children's food and dairy products, including domestic procurement and supply of primary raw materials."
FSS_34:
"Goal/Purpose": "To increase the meal allowances for pupils in nurseries, state schools, vocational education and training institutions, and boarding houses in line with nutritional requirements and the rate of inflation, and ensure the supervision and involvement of parents and guardians.",
"Action/Intervention": "Transition to a principle of shared responsibility for nursery children's meal costs between the state, parents and guardians; take measures to increase meal allowances to ensure adequate calorie and nutritional content; establish the necessary legal framework to transition per-child funding for nursery children's meals and primary school pupils' lunches to cost-based financing in line with inflation levels, taking into account nutritional quality; establish an electronic system for the integrated management and provision of food production and service for nursery and school children; support, through tax and incentive policies, the establishment of an electronic integrated management and supply system for the production and service of meals in nursery and school dormitories, including the supply of factory-prepared meat, vegetables, milk and dairy products, flour, semi-finished products and ingredients to enterprises.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Nurseries, state schools, vocational education and training institutions, boarding houses, and nursery and school food production and meal service systems.",
"Target Audience": "Pupils in nurseries, state schools, vocational education and training institutions, and boarding houses; nursery children; primary school pupils; parents and guardians; the state; and enterprises involved in meal production and supply.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Meal allowances increased in line with nutritional requirements and inflation; adequate calorie and nutritional content of meals ensured; per-child meal funding transitioned to cost-based financing in line with inflation; supervision and involvement of parents and guardians ensured; and electronic integrated management and supply systems for meal production and service established."
FSS_35:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish a system to provide financial support for the new establishment of processing plants for dry milk, table salt, edible oils, potatoes, various types of rice and sugar.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide financial support for establishing new processing plants, including: establishment of a factory to process 20.0 thousand litres of liquid milk per day and produce milk powder; establishment of a factory to process 15 tonnes of edible salt per day; establishment of a potato processing plant for the production of starch and potato products; and establishment of a sugar refinery.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food processing and agro-processing sector.",
"Target Audience": "Entities establishing new processing plants for dry milk, table salt, edible oils, potatoes, various types of rice and sugar.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A system for financial support is established for new processing plants, including supported establishment of milk powder, edible salt, potato processing, and sugar refining facilities."
FSS_36:
"Goal/Purpose": "To establish a new fleet of specialised food transport vehicles (road, rail and air) and create a system for transporting domestic and imported food raw materials and products.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a new fleet of specialised food transport vehicles across road, rail and air; create a system for transporting domestic and imported food raw materials and products; establish a unified electronic database and system for the registration and management of food transport, logistics, and cargo turnover; provide support through lending and tax policies to increase the availability of specialised food transport vehicles; support the establishment of the fleet and create a legal framework.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food transport, logistics, and cargo turnover system for domestic and imported food raw materials and products.",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for food transport, logistics, cargo turnover, and the establishment and management of specialised food transport vehicles.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A new fleet of specialised food transport vehicles is established, and a system is created for transporting domestic and imported food raw materials and products, supported by an electronic registration and management database, lending and tax policy support, and a legal framework."
FSS_37:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve the storage and handling of food raw materials and products through specialised facilities, a unified registration system, support for drying, freezing and preserving equipment, and development of domestic production of food containers and packaging.",
"Action/Intervention": "Store food raw materials and products in specialised warehouses and storages that meet standard requirements; establish a unified registration system, including a unified electronic database and storage system for food raw materials and products in purpose-built warehouses and storerooms; support the supply of small and medium-sized equipment for drying, freezing and preserving; provide tax support by exempting food processing machinery and equipment from customs duties and deferring tax payments; support the establishment of a factory for producing plastic crates for the storage and transport of vegetables; support establishing a factory to produce plastic crates for storing and transporting vegetables, wooden seedbeds and plant nursery pots; develop domestic production of food containers and packaging.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food storage, food processing, and food supply infrastructure.",
"Target Audience": "Food raw material and product storage operators, food processing machinery and equipment suppliers, factories producing plastic crates, wooden seedbeds and plant nursery pots, and food container and packaging producers.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Food raw materials and products are stored in facilities that meet standard requirements, a unified electronic registration and storage database/system is established, supply of drying, freezing and preserving equipment is supported, and domestic production of food containers and packaging is developed."
FSS_38:
"Goal/Purpose": "To fully utilise the capacity of food processing plants and improve product flavour and quality, packaging and containers, product variety, export-oriented branding, and stable factory operations.",
"Action/Intervention": "Modernise food processing equipment; improve product flavour and quality; improve packaging and containers; increase product variety; create and develop export-oriented brands and products; support the stable operation of food processing plants with working capital.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food processing sector.",
"Target Audience": "Food processing plants.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Full utilisation of food processing plant capacity, improved product flavour and quality, improved packaging and containers, increased product variety, development of export-oriented brands and products, and more stable factory operations."
FSS_39:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase production of dietary supplements, biologically active food products, and functional foods.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support production of dietary supplements, biologically active food products, and functional foods through policy support.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food production and food products sector.",
"Target Audience": "Producers of dietary supplements, biologically active food products, and functional foods.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased production of dietary supplements, biologically active food products, and functional foods."
FSS_40:
"Goal/Purpose": "To fully define food safety indicators nationwide and establish a system for pre-shipment laboratory analysis and inspection of exported and imported food raw materials and products.",
"Action/Intervention": "Modernise laboratory analysis and testing methodologies nationwide; fully define food safety parameters; provide technical expertise and equipment; establish and conduct pre-shipment laboratory testing, monitoring and inspection of imported and exported food raw materials and products; amend the legal framework; strengthen border and national accredited laboratories; strengthen human resources and create stable working conditions.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food safety, laboratory analysis, and inspection of imported and exported food raw materials and products.",
"Target Audience": "Border laboratories, national accredited laboratories, and human resources involved in laboratory testing, monitoring, and inspection.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Nationwide food safety indicators are fully defined; a pre-shipment laboratory analysis and inspection system for exported and imported food raw materials and products is established; border and national accredited laboratories are strengthened."
FSS_41:
"Goal/Purpose": "To promote the proper, appropriate and civilised consumption of food and drink through training, publicity and educational activities.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organise training, publicity and educational activities on the proper, appropriate and civilised consumption of food and drink; provide support for educational and awareness-raising initiatives on the proper consumption of food and drink organised by citizens, the private sector, non-governmental organisations and institutions; include the ‘Food Safety Hour’ programme in all television and radio schedules at fixed times each week as part of social responsibility, involving the public in efforts to promote proper food consumption; organise targeted measures to enhance public food and nutrition education.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food and drink consumption; public food and nutrition education; media and public awareness.",
"Target Audience": "The public; citizens, the private sector, non-governmental organisations, institutions, television and radio broadcasters.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased public education, awareness and involvement in the proper consumption of food and drink, and enhanced public food and nutrition education."
